name: Ring Push-Up
cues: Hang the rings just above the floor
Grip the rings with straight arms and your body in one line
Keep the rings close to your sides as you lower
Press up and turn your thumbs slightly out at the top

Straps are not gated, so I measured them: the strap axis passes 69 mm from the humerus axis at the bottom (f67) and 89 mm from the shoulder segment. That is close to the surface but not through it.
